_comment: Hand-maintained document catalog for the RAG knowledge base. Add an entry here for every PDF placed in pdfs/ (keyed by filename stem); chunking fails loudly for uncatalogued PDFs. Tags must come from _tag_vocabulary. This file doubles as the corpus table for the paper.

_tag_vocabulary.electrochemistry-fundamentals: thermodynamics, Nernst equation, electrode kinetics (e.g. Butler-Volmer), physical meaning of voltage/current behavior
_tag_vocabulary.degradation-mechanisms: SEI growth, lithium plating, loss of active material / lithium inventory, capacity fade physics
_tag_vocabulary.charging-protocols: CC/CV, fast charging, charge/discharge protocol design and terminology
_tag_vocabulary.battery-characterization: cycling tests, EIS, pulse tests, capacity and internal resistance measurement methods
_tag_vocabulary.battery-lifetime: aging studies, RUL/SoH estimation, early-cycle lifetime prediction
_tag_vocabulary.thermal-effects: temperature dependence of battery behavior, thermal management
_tag_vocabulary.cell-design: cell formats, materials and manufacturing, series/parallel pack behavior
